summary: Iteration 4 testing complete - All new features implemented and working correctly. Backend APIs verified: GET /api/users/{id} with relationship status, joined_routes/events counts, POST /api/friends/remove, PATCH /api/me privacy settings, GET /api/notifications, GET /api/friends/requests, GET /api/marketplace/listings. Frontend code structure verified with correct data-testid attributes and profile navigation links.
critical_code_review_comments: profile/[id].tsx: All relationship-based action buttons have correct data-testid attributes (add-friend-btn, send-message-btn, remove-friend-btn, cancel-request-btn, accept-request-btn, edit-profile-btn)
profile/edit.tsx: Privacy toggles implemented with data-testid (privacy-location-toggle, privacy-km-toggle, privacy-active-toggle, privacy-routes-btn)
community.tsx: Friend requests and search results have Pressable wrapping avatar/username that links to /profile/{id}
shop.tsx: Seller name in listing cards has Pressable that links to /profile/{seller_id}
notifications/index.tsx: Friend request icon has Pressable that links to /profile/{id}
MapCanvas.native.tsx: openDirections function implemented with Linking.openURL for gas/service markers, Callout with directionsBtn style present
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 features fully tested. Key endpoints verified: /api/users/{id} returns relationship field (self, friends, not_friends, request_sent, request_received) and joined_routes/joined_events counts. /api/friends/remove endpoint works correctly. Privacy settings (location_visible, km_visible, last_active_visible, routes_visible) save and retrieve properly via PATCH/GET /api/me. Frontend data-testid attributes confirmed in profile/[id].tsx, profile/edit.tsx. Profile navigation links confirmed in community.tsx, shop.tsx, notifications/index.tsx. MapCanvas.native.tsx has openDirections function for gas/service markers.
